description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'View' within the SuiteCRM's Administration Search MVC module, providing utility functions for rendering templates, configuration handling, and button HTML generation for search configuration pages.

classes.name: View
classes.description: An abstract class extending SuiteCRM's base View, providing methods for pre-display setup, button HTML generation, and engine listing for the search configuration interface.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Sets up Smarty variables including localization strings, language settings, configuration data, and warning logs prior to rendering the view.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Returns HTML for cancel and save buttons utilized in the configuration interface.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns an array mapping search engine identifiers to their human-readable translations.
